card.name: Punctuation after neuromuscular blocker names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (comma, 'or', 'and', 'of', open parenthesis) right after a neuromuscular blocking drug name such as vecuronium, pancuronium or rocuronium, or in anesthesia text on muscle blockade.

modes.description: 'of' or 'For' in phrases about neuromuscular blockade, dosing or ED95 in anesthesia.

card.writes: Suppresses word starts like 'comp' and 'enh', and promotes 'trust'; the effect is unclear and looks weakly related to the text.
card.plain: It fires on the comma, 'or' or 'and' that follows a muscle-relaxant drug name in anesthesia lists.
